text:
Aya (CS): quick draft: 'Kickoff warmup checklist' for customers — one pager they can run themselves. Goal: fewer cold-starts, clear rollback, and a 72h follow-up tick. Pls sanity-check.

Tom (Eng): love. Keep it tiny: ask for 20 representative prompts, suggest batch_size=5 (latency/throughput balance), prefill_concurrency=2 for first 10m.

Rina (SRE): ops guardrails: alert if 5xx > 3% over 3m or p95 > 1s. On alert: halve batch_size, route 25% to fallback-quantized, and notify #release-war-room. Add observability queries.

Oliver (PM): capture renewal signals: baseline p90, cache-hit % at 24h, error-budget% used, and CS sentiment at 72h (green/amber/red + note). Include in kickoff email.

Aya (CS): customer-friendly one-liner to paste: "We'll run a 20-45m warmup using your top 20 prompts to populate cache and tune batching. We'll share a 24h snapshot and schedule a 72h check-in. If errors spike we'll switch to a compact fallback and notify you."

cs-bot: reminder set for @Aya (CS) in 72 hours. :white_check_mark:
